messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
We intentionally had a very short ceremony planned so people could get to the reception.

output.original_text: We intentionally had a very short ceremony planned so people could get to the reception.
output.joy: We excitedly planned a very short ceremony so everyone could quickly enjoy the reception!
output.sadness: We had to plan a very short ceremony so people could rush to the reception, which feels a bit disappointing.
output.fear: We had a short ceremony planned, hoping people would make it to the reception on time without any issues.
output.anger: We only planned a short ceremony, which really annoys me because it feels rushed just to get to the reception.
output.surprise: To my surprise, we planned a very short ceremony so people could head to the reception right away!
output.disgust: I can’t believe we actually planned a very short ceremony just so people could get to the reception—what a shallow priority!
